definitions.gloss: outsourcing, subcontracting, placing an order outside
definitions.explanation: Ordering work or services from an external company or individual rather than handling it internally. Common in business and manufacturing.

examples.japanese: ⟦デザイン→デザイン：03860_dezain⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{外注|がいちゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

⟦{人手|ひとで}→人手：25438_hitode⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{一部|いちぶ}→一部：06783_ichibu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{業務|ぎょうむ}→業務：09630_gyoumu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{外注|がいちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: Since we're short-staffed, we outsourced some of the work.

examples.japanese: {外注|がいちゅう}⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦うまく→うまい：01279_umai⟧いかず、⟦{納期|のうき}→納期：07772_nouki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{間|ま}に{合|あ}わなかった→間に合う：01142_maniau⟧。
examples.english: Communication with the subcontractor didn't go well, and we missed the deadline.

notes:
{外注|がいちゅう} means outsourcing or subcontracting — ordering work from an external company or individual rather than handling it in-house.

FORMS:
⟦{外|がい}→外〜：03948_gai⟧ (outside) + ⟦{注|ちゅう}→注：03434_chuu⟧ (order). Literally "outside order."

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {外注|がいちゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to outsource
- {外注|がいちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to send out for outsourcing (very common)
- {外注|がいちゅう}⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧: subcontractor, outsourcing partner
- {外注|がいちゅう}⟦{費|ひ}→費：09877_hi⟧: outsourcing costs
- {外注|がいちゅう}⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧: outsourcing management

USAGE:
Very common in business Japanese, especially in IT, manufacturing, and creative industries. Freelancers (⟦フリーランス→フリーランス：06152_furiiransu⟧) are often hired through {外注|がいちゅう}.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {外注|がいちゅう}: outsourcing (specific work ordered from outside)
- ⟦{委託|いたく}→委託：05620_itaku⟧: commissioning, entrusting (broader, more formal)
- ⟦{下請|したう}け→下請け：10898_shitauke⟧: subcontracting (emphasizes the subordinate relationship)
